title: ONE MODEL, MANY MORALS: UNCOVERING CROSS-LINGUISTIC MISALIGNMENTS IN COMPUTATIONAL MORAL REASONING
reasoning: The entire paper is dedicated to evaluating and benchmarking moral reasoning in LLMs across different languages. It uses moral benchmarks like MoralExceptQA and ETHICS and analyzes model behavior using ethical frameworks such as Deontology, Utilitarianism, and Divine Command Theory.
